fields.question: Does the proposed filter reduce false alarms on independent synthetic sensor series?
fields.population: Synthetic sensor series generated from the declared fixture family.
fields.intervention: Run the proposed filter on each series.
fields.comparator: Run the fixed baseline filter on the same series.
fields.estimand: Mean paired false-alarm-rate difference per independent series.
fields.control: Use a no-signal series with the same nuisance noise generator.
fields.measurement_window: One fixed 1000-sample window per held-out series.
fields.exclusion_rule: Exclude a series only for the prespecified nonfinite-input failure.
fields.falsifier: No reduction in the primary metric beyond the prespecified useful margin.
fields.harm_limit: Stop if false negatives increase above the prespecified safety threshold.
fields.cheapest_decisive_measurement: Run the paired filters on one sealed synthetic development batch before planning the held-out study.

assumptions.statement: Series are independently generated at the study unit.
assumptions.check: Inspect generator seeds and group identifiers before fitting or testing.
